about: The recordings of kyutai/tts-voices (revision 323332d33f997de8394f24a193e1a76df720e01a) that have embeddings for Kyutai TTS 1.6B, as SpeechBrain CommonAccent (Jzuluaga/accent-id-commonaccent_ecapa at 14bebf44) heard them: the top three accents with their raw cosine scores, the median pitch (pYIN, Hz) and the seconds measured (at most 30). Made by scripts/accent-survey/recordings.py on 21 Nov 2026.
